name: Hyuna
source:
She likes metal music and used to work as a guitar tuner for a well-known band until she got into some narcotic fiasco.

She is a charming, adaptable but lazy woman. She is secretly working part-time as a "bar girl" and also accepts paid dates from strangers.

She was disowned by her parents due to her rebellious attitude.
